description:
Working at Freudenberg: "We will wow your world!" This is our promise. As a global technology group, we not only make the world cleaner, healthier and more comfortable, but also offer our 52,000 employees a networked and diverse environment where everyone can thrive individually. Be surprised and experience your own wow moments. Together with our partners, customers and the world of science, we develop leading-edge technologies, and excellent products and services for about 40 markets and for thousands of applications: seals, vibration control components, batteries and fuel cells, technical textiles, filters, cleaning technologies and products, specialty chemicals and medical products.

You support our team as Procurement Professional with German

Responsibilities:

  • Trigger purchase orders for info records stored in the system;
  • Verify and enter order confirmations (quantities and delivery date), making sure a of 90% accuracy in SAP;
  • Verify the invoices (quantity variance) and release them if necessary;
  • Tracking the deliveries (dunning if necessary), tracking of overdue deliveries;
  • Ensure compliance with OTD and a low stock level;
  • Execution of the intercompany order including deposit of the info record;
  • Forwarding and tracking of Q-notifications internally with quality assurance and externally to the supplier;
  • Ensuring the completion/fulfillment of Prio Liste requested materials in due time for production planning;
  • Assure timely response and resolution for the WE list items.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor degree in economics/business administration and/ or at least 2-3 years of experience in the procurement of external direct materials is mandatory;
  • Fluent in English and German;
  • Fact-driven and strong technical and procurement understanding, detailed oriented attitude to problem solving and identify solutions;
  • Hand-on experience in SAP S4 (MM), or different ERP system;
  • Experience with MS Office tools.

If you like to make a difference and if you would like to be a part of a growing, successful company, then this is the moment to join Freudenberg and become part of a great team!
